investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order
Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A brothel is a place resorted toby persons of opposite sexes for the purpose of illicit intercourse, althoughit is not necessary that the women using the premises are prostitutes or that paymentsare made to them; Winter v Woolfe [1931] 1 KB 549.
(ii) The use of premises as a brothel is a matter of fact for the jury todecide, the whole or part of a house may be used where there is use by morethan one prostitute.
(iii) Premises which are resorted to for the purposes of lewd homosexualpractices shall be treated as brothels for the purposes of sections 33, 34, and35 of this Act and section 6 of the Sexual Offences Act 1967.
